info.title: Notify API
info.description: B2B transactional messaging API (specs 0001–0007). Generated from the Zod schemas in `@notify/contracts` — do not edit by hand.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Portal sign-up and the account's businesses.

bearerAuth.description: Business session token, public API key, or mobile device access token (per realm).

post.summary: Submit an OTP/transactional message
post.description: Accepts the message for async processing and returns a message id. Promotional content and unapproved senders are rejected synchronously with `422`; a frozen billing account is `402`.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

402.description: Billing account is frozen for an overdue invoice

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different request

422.description: Rejected at intake (promotional content or unapproved sender)

post.summary: Request a link domain (starts `pending`)
post.description: Messages may only link to approved domains (and their subdomains); a message with any other link is refused at intake with `422` (`POLICY_REJECTION`, path `body`). Accepts a bare domain or a pasted URL and stores the normalised domain. An operator approves it.

post.description: Requires `domain.review` (`ops`/`superadmin`). The change and its reason are audited (ADR-0013) in the same transaction. Idempotent: setting the current status returns the domain unchanged and records no audit event.

get.summary: Get the business's own SMS gateway
get.description: The gateway used for this business's SMS fallback, or an empty body when it has none and the platform default sends its SMS. Secret credentials are never returned: `secretsSet` lists the secret fields that hold a value.

200.description: The saved gateway (empty when none is configured)

put.summary: Choose an SMS gateway and set its credentials
put.description: Supported providers and their credential fields are listed in `SMS_GATEWAY_PROVIDERS` (`@notify/contracts`). A secret left out keeps its stored value while the provider is unchanged. Owner or admin only.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

delete.summary: Remove the business's own SMS gateway
delete.description: The business goes back to the platform default gateway. Owner or admin only.

post.description: Records a bKash send-money for staff to verify. A verified payment credits the balance, which then settles the oldest open invoices.

get.description: Admin (staff) realm. The operator is a separate identity from a business user (see docs/architecture/auth.md).

get.description: The admin directory. Optional `search` matches the business name or owner email case-insensitively.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

post.summary: Manually adjust the balance of the account that owns a business
post.description: A top-up, admin debit, or correction. `amount` is signed (positive credits, negative debits) and its sign must agree with `entryType`. Idempotent on the `Idempotency-Key` header. Requires the `finance` or `superadmin` role (ADR-0012). Every adjustment is audited.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

post.summary: Suspend or reactivate a business
post.description: The operator abuse-review action. A `suspended` business can neither sign in nor authenticate an API key, so it can no longer submit messages. Requires the `ops` or `superadmin` role. The change and its reason are audited (ADR-0013) in the same transaction. Idempotent: setting the current status returns the business unchanged and records no audit event.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: List a business's sender IDs (all statuses)
Get the active business's delivery settings

put.description: When `smsFallback` is true (the default), a message whose app notification cannot be delivered is sent by SMS. When false it fails instead (`push_failed_no_fallback`). Owner or admin only.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: Sender-ID review queue across businesses
get.description: Sender IDs of every business in one status (default `pending`), oldest first, each with its business. Review one with `POST /admin/businesses/{id}/senders/{senderId}/status`.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

post.summary: Approve or reject a sender ID
post.description: The operator sender-ID review action. Only an `approved` sender may be used on a message. Requires the `ops` or `superadmin` role. The change and its reason are audited (ADR-0013) in the same transaction. Idempotent: setting the current status returns the sender unchanged and records no audit event.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: Read the operator audit trail (newest first, keyset paginated)
get.description: Every operator write is recorded as an `audit.recorded` event in the same transaction as the change and lands in the ClickHouse `audit_log`. Optional `actor`, `action`, and `target` filters are exact matches (ADR-0013).

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: Gateway/carrier health
get.description: The circuit-breaker state of every push provider (`apps/delivery.provider_health`) and SMS carrier (`apps/smsgw.carrier_health`). Read-only operator observability.

503.description: A gateway-health source is temporarily unavailable

get.summary: List SMS carrier accounts and routes

post.summary: Add a carrier account
post.description: Requires `gateways.manage`. One account per carrier. Secrets are never stored: the carrier's key is an environment variable of the SMS gateway, and the response reports whether it is set.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

409.description: This carrier already has an account

patch.summary: Edit or disable a carrier account
patch.description: Requires `gateways.manage`. A disabled account takes its routes out of service.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

delete.description: Requires `gateways.manage`. Refused while routes still point at the carrier.

422.description: The account is still in use by routes

post.summary: Add a carrier route
post.description: Requires `gateways.manage`. The longest matching prefix wins, then the lowest priority.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

409.description: A route for this prefix, carrier and priority already exists

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

409.description: A route for this prefix, carrier and priority already exists

get.summary: Operator-sent app messages (newest first, keyset paginated, filterable)
get.description: Every business's messages plus the console's operator broadcasts. Filter by `businessId` (the all-zero platform id selects operator broadcasts), delivery `status`, the `channel` that accepted it, the broadcast `kind` (`app`, `sms`, `auto`) and a `from`/`to` UTC day range. The platform's login OTPs are never returned. Requires `mobile_users.view`.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: Totals and breakdowns for operator-sent app messages
get.description: Counts by status and channel plus the most common failure reasons, under the same `channel`, `kind` and date filters as the list (`status` is not a filter here). Requires `mobile_users.view`.

400.description: Request body or parameters are invalid

get.summary: One message, from any business, with its event trail
get.description: `trailAvailable` is false when the log store could not be reached; the message record is still returned. Requires `mobile_users.view`.

post.summary: Mark an inbox message as opened
post.description: Records the first time the recipient opened the message (on any device). Repeating the call keeps the original time, so it is safe to retry. A message that is not in the caller's inbox is a `404`.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the message from the caller's own inbox. The sending business and operators still see it. Undo with `POST /users/messages/{id}/restore`. A message that is not in the caller's inbox is a `404`.

post.summary: Permit a business by scanning its QR code
post.description: A scan is explicit consent: the relationship becomes `allowed` immediately, even over an earlier decline. Idempotent for a business that is already permitted.

put.summary: Allow a company, or decline it for a period
put.description: Declining takes `3d`, `7d`, `1m`, `6m` or `lifetime`. Declining a company that was already permitted removes it from the permitted list. Repeating the same answer changes nothing.
